summary: First full test iteration of Smart System (Arabic RTL sales/distribution Expo app + FastAPI/Mongo). Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (100%), covering auth/me, activation (LIC + EMP codes), trial, developer stats/licenses CRUD/org patch (suspend+restore), products CRUD + role gating, purchases/stock increase, customers CRUD + statement, employee invite/list/delete (EMP code), deliveries (warehouse->distributor + stock validation), my/inventory, sales (agent-only, deducts inventory, updates customer balance, CASH/CREDIT), collections (balance cap enforced), sales-returns, stats/overview (owner-only gross_profit, agent-scoped), stats/agents, and permission denials (403) across roles. Frontend web preview (390x844): login screen renders, token injection via localStorage works for all 5 roles. Owner sees 4 tabs (الرئيسية/المخزون/العملاء/الإدارة); product add, invite employee (EMP code shown), owner more screen all work. Agent sees 4 tabs (الرئيسية/بيع/العملاء/السجل); new-sale screen with customer select/line select/paid/notes/total/submit works, sales history shows INV- entries, customers list exposes collect-customer buttons. Accountant home shows overview incl. المشتريات and tنبيهات نقص المخزون. Developer dashboard shows 3 tabs (الرئيسية/التراخيص/المؤسسات) with stats. New-user activation screen shows both code input and trial form. Minor UX issue: sheet footer buttons (save-product-button, create-invite-button) can be below the fold on 390x844 and require scroll-into-view.

minor.issue: extend_days always flips plan to LICENSE even when org is already LICENSE – harmless but silently overrides TRIAL->LICENSE conversion without explicit action; acceptable per design but worth a note.

On successful EMP- activation, response does not refresh org object for employee (user has no org expiration check at activation time – not a bug but worth confirming suspended org blocks EMP activation too). Not blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: save-product-button is outside viewport at 390x844; user must scroll inside the sheet to reach it. Requires scroll_into_view in automated tests.
create-invite-button footer is below fold on 390x844; needs scroll to reach.

issues: Bottom-sheet footer buttons occasionally pushed below viewport on 390x844; consider sticky footer or shorter form.

action_items: (Optional UX) Make bottom-sheet footer buttons sticky so save-product-button and create-invite-button remain visible on 390x844 without scrolling.
Consider validating that suspended org also blocks EMP- activation (currently /activate does not consult org.status).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py single file 681 lines – within acceptable limit but close to 700; splitting into routers (auth/dev/catalog/sales/stats) would improve maintainability.
Good: _id stripped via NO_ID projection on every find; env vars used for Mongo/DB; FastAPI validates with Pydantic; counters used for sequential invoice/receipt/return numbers.
DEVELOPER_EMAILS="" in .env combined with 'first user becomes DEVELOPER' bootstrap logic is a secure default but worth documenting.
frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL); api.ts correctly reads it – acceptable Expo convention.
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_test.py once at start. Tests created TEST_LIC_ORG license, TEST_TRIAL_ORG trial org, TEST_منتج/TEST_UI_P1 products, TEST_عميل customer, EMP invitations, 1 sale/collection/return, and left them in DB. Re-run seed_test.py to restore test_token_new to unactivated state before next run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest runs sequentially (-n 0) because tests share STATE across classes via module dict. Pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope so always invoke with explicit `-n 0`. Token injection pattern for Expo web: localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('<token>')) + full page reload. Known-good tokens: test_token_dev/owner/agent/acct/new. Backend URL from frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://text-fixer-32.preview.emergentagent.com). Re-run /app/backend/seed_test.py to reset test_token_new to role=null before activation/trial flow tests.
